LIT dashboard — Schools, districts & stakeholders overlap

A visual read of where the four partners' work overlaps, drawn from the combined school lists and workplans — where their activities collide across schools, regions, districts, stakeholders and systems.

Last update: October 2026
Partner Status applies to scorecards, maps & charts

Zanzibar now shows its 236 partner schools (ACSL/VVOB); dot positions there are approximate (region-level). The full Zanzibar school registry is not yet included, so Zanzibar totals and coverage reflect partner schools only.

Regional footprint

Filter by partner count, or select partners to find where they co-exist
This map shows how many of the four partners work in each region (1–3), shaded light-to-deep teal; amber marks regions with no programme presence. Each region label shows the region name with its number of shared schools (schools reached by 2 or more partners) in brackets, and the coverage rate on the line below. Hover a region to see: the partners present and each partner's school count, shared schools, districts with overlap, total secondary schools, and coverage. Coverage % = schools reached by at least one partner ÷ total secondary schools.

District coverage — click a region to zoom in

districts shaded by partners present · click to zoom, hover for detail
This map shows how many partners work in each district — amber = none, light teal = 1, teal = 2. Use Go to region (or click a region) to zoom in and read its district names and coverage. Hover a district to see: partners present and each partner's school count, two-/one-/no-partner school counts, total secondary schools, and coverage. Coverage % = schools with at least one partner ÷ total secondary schools.

School coverage — every secondary school

one dot per school · scroll or use +/− to zoom, drag to pan
Every secondary school in the national registry as a dot, placed at its ward, coloured by partner coverage — amber = no partner, light teal = 1, teal = 2. Zoom in (+/− or scroll) down to ward level and drag to pan; hover a dot for the school name, its partner(s), region, district and ward. Positions are ward-level approximations (the registry has no GPS).
